publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: Storage discovery depends on class registration
record.method: Registry/metaclass inspection and positive/negative media controls
record.observation: Removing the original flash devices also removed the demand that loaded IOStorageFamily. Once the original family was initialized, a concrete native provider matched the generic block driver and published a synthetic GPT partition.
record.limits: Class identity and matching are necessary, but do not certify later lifetime, concurrency or filesystem behavior.

exhibits.title: Positive and deliberately invalid GPT cards
exhibits.interpretation: The transport still worked for the invalid card. GPT rejection therefore distinguishes data validation from mere I/O completion; the fallback partition is not a GPT success.
